q: In the context of continuation methods (numerical bifurcation analysis), pseudo-arclength continuation is used to follow solution branches past:
opts: Fold (saddle-node) points where the standard parameter-continuation fails (vertical tangent)
exp: Pseudo-arclength continuation parameterises the solution branch by arclength (in solution × parameter space) rather than by the parameter alone. This handles fold points (turning points) where the branch turns back, allowing continuation past the fold.
